verdict.rationale: Zulip's core model gives every conversation its own topic inside a channel, so side discussions stay separated and grouped (zulip-docs-16, zulip-docs-29, zulip-docs-21). Multiple independent users call threading Zulip's most important feature, and one notes you can create threads on the fly from existing messages (zulip-comm-5, zulip-comm-20, zulip-comm-15). Threads are topic-based rather than a reply chain hanging off one specific message, and one user reports occasionally posting to the wrong thread (zulip-comm-9). missing for 10: first-party docs on replying to a specific message to spawn or continue a thread, explicit evidence that a thread stays anchored to its originating message.
